title: Computational shortcut from local constancy
html:
Remark. Computational shortcut from local constancy

Remark (computational shortcut from local constancy). Following the unstable-atom "Computational shortcut", we restrict expensive computations (per-generator \hat V_i^{\mathrm{full}} extraction in the tower formula mass-endomorphism-tower) to exact evaluation only at points of the phase-boundary variety \mathcal{B}. In the complement Q \setminus \mathcal{B}, all shadow prices, the filtration, and the per-generator data are locally constant (by local constancy of confinement). Linear interpolation between nearest magic-number anchors is mathematically justified.
